summary: The authors estimated one ALAC-versus-WPI effect across four brain regions using 91 libraries from 23 piglets. Their result file contains zero genes passing selection. HypoExplorer estimates a sex-adjusted effect in hypothalamus alone and retains the WPI library the authors excluded. No public author result supplied gene-level effects for that registered contrast. [Author analysis](https://github.com/xuahe/piglet-ila-variability-study/blob/7db301b17fe77310e5765809c9c683f821327c10/RNAseq_data_analysis/DESeq2_analysis.html)
openIssues: Reopen if the authors release P16 hypothalamus-only ALAC-versus-WPI gene effects with both ILA groups combined, documented sex adjustment and explicit handling of library 214 (GSM8626987).
For the separate ILA-producer-versus-WPI analysis, Supplementary Table 3 and the deposited CSV report opposite ALOX5AP effect signs. This discrepancy does not affect the closure.
